g.text: Cluster.forecastRegion holds the enum value; this
association carries the forecast text and validity
period the flag was derived from (1.3.4, 1.3.5).
Written only when a work order is Verified (8.3.12).
Feeds the DaysSinceLastTreatment driver, so the next
score must be lower (4.1.17). This closes the loop.
One role per account (2.2.1). The real NEA / town-council
split of task types is a recorded simplification, not an
omission: one Operations Manager, one Cleaning Crew.
